name: branch-nested-object-body-match
description: branch's body condition matches when the expected value is a nested object that deep-equals the captured value, running the matching case's steps instead of falling to default
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: branch nested object match
proxy: optional
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- capture: "POST /login as: loginRsp"
- branch:
    from: loginRsp
    on:
      - match:
          body:
            "$.user":
              id: 1
              role: admin
        do:
          - screenshot: matched
    default:
      - screenshot: fallback
